name: Astera Labs
thesis: Connectivity silicon (retimers, Scorpio switches) inside AI racks; Q2 revenue $392M, +104% YoY, with Scorpio X set to become the largest product line in Q3. $358.86 at 10:30 ET Thursday (+0.8%), one of the few AI names up on a day the 10-year hit 5.33%. Fubon Buy with a $500 target; no company news since the last run.
risks: ~175x earnings and within 10% of the $390 consensus target, so the rebound from the Sep 15 low of $251.97 is largely done. Few hyperscaler customers, and Nvidia NVLink competes directly; a yield spike hits this multiple first.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Top custom AI chip (XPU) and AI networking supplier; Q3 FY26 AI revenue $16.7B, +221% YoY, Q4 guide ~$34.8B. Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows Broadcom lending it up to $42B in convertible notes, about a third of a $125.2B five-year TPU capacity deal with Google and Broadcom, and Anthropic becomes Broadcom's largest compute customer in 2027. $347.36 at 10:31 ET (-1.1%) after a 0.6% premarket pop faded; consensus target $532 (+53%) is still the widest gap among the AI names.
risks: Broadcom is now supplier, lessor and lender to a customer that lost over $8B operating in 2025 on $4.6B revenue; the prospectus itself flags the conflict. China's SASAC is surveying Broadcom switches in state data centres, and 5.33% 10-year yields (highest since 2002) press every long-duration AI name.
catalyst: Q4 FY2026 earnings ~2026-12-10 (est.); Anthropic IPO pricing; any SASAC guidance on switches

name: SK hynix
thesis: Holds ~58% of HBM revenue share; Q2 operating income KRW 60.5T at a 76% margin, ~9x earnings. Seoul closed Thursday at KRW 1,833,000 (+3.2%) as the KOSPI rose 1.95% to 6,971 on Micron's $61.5B guide and its line that supply is tighter in 2027-28 than 2026; the ADR is $183.70 at 10:31 ET (-0.2%), having already priced the move Wednesday. The company said Thursday no decision has been made on Solidigm's financing and any route will put existing shareholders first.
risks: A Solidigm listing (Bloomberg's $100B figure) adds an ownership layer and the stock fell 6% on the first report. Micron closed -2.5% after its own beat, which says the memory trade is fully priced near term; Bernstein cut its target on slower HBM4 pricing and CXMT is closing the gap.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-27 (est.); any Solidigm financing decision

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: On-site fuel cells for AI data centres; Q2 revenue $1.07B, +166%, 2026 guide $3.9-4.2B. Barclays lifted its target to $308 from $276 Thursday (Equal Weight) on the new Fremont facility that could double capacity; $278.69 at 10:30 ET (+0.6%) after Wednesday's 4.9% drop. RBC $335, Morgan Stanley $310, Jefferies $264; still +220% YTD.
risks: Trades near the $286 consensus target at ~370x earnings, and 5-11% daily swings are normal. Oracle's Jupiter force majeure stands: gas pipeline slipped to Feb 2027, fuel-cell air permit due Nov 23. Several class actions pending.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings 2026-10-27; Jupiter air-quality permit decision by 2026-11-23

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Bottleneck supplier of gas turbines and grid gear for AI power; Q2 orders $24.2B (+88% organic), backlog ~$176B. $954.01 at 10:30 ET (+0.4%), a third quiet day after the NRC construction permit for TVA's BWRX-300 at Clinch River; $0.50 quarterly dividend (record Oct 27, paid Nov 24). Consensus target ~$1,237 (+30%).
risks: Premium multiple on a cyclical business (GLJ Sell, $470 target) with the 30-year Treasury at 5.67%, its highest since 2002. Tariffs cost $100-200M in 2026, offshore wind still loses money, and TVA has no construction date or cost-sharing deal yet for the SMR.

name: Vertiv Holdings
thesis: Power, thermal and liquid-cooling infrastructure for AI data centres; Q2 net sales $3.27B (+24%, 18% organic) at a 22.6% adjusted operating margin, 2026 guide $14.0B. $240.40 at 10:31 ET (-0.4%), a third soft day on no company news after BofA added it to its US 1 List and Wells Fargo started at Overweight $340. Consensus $338 (+41%).
risks: 56x earnings prices in the guide; Q2 organic growth was 18% with acquisitions and FX doing the rest, so the second half has to accelerate. Hyperscaler capex concentration, and Schneider, Eaton and Asian OEMs compete in liquid cooling. Medium conviction until Q3 confirms the ramp.
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-10-22 (est.); KES deal close Q4

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Q2 revenue $1.31B (+32%) at a 57% adjusted EBITDA margin. $112.00 at 10:30 ET (-0.4%), a second day of drift after the summit (Robinhood Agents on OpenAI and Anthropic models, crypto perps, 24/7 trading on select stocks, weekend equities in 2027). Goldman called the launches proof of product velocity; KeyBanc $140, Morgan Stanley $150, Goldman $145, consensus ~$131-133 (+17%).
risks: Perps and autonomous AI agents draw regulators; two engineers were charged Sep 15 with insider trading on crypto listings. Revenue swings with retail and crypto volumes at ~50x earnings, and Robinhood bills for model usage without disclosed economics.
catalyst: Robinhood Agents rollout in October; Q3 2026 earnings ~2026-11-04 (est.)

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: LatAm's leading e-commerce and fintech platform; Q2 revenue $10.17B (+50%), the 30th straight quarter above 30%. $1,695.18 at 10:30 ET (-1.9%), giving back Wednesday's gain on no company news as the 10-year hit 5.33%; down 12% since Sep 14. Consensus target $2,272 (+34%).
risks: Operating margin is 6.7%, down from 12.2%, as it spends on shipping, credit and one-hour Sao Paulo delivery. Nu is competing hard in lending, and 5%+ US yields drain emerging-market flows, which is what today's move looks like.

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Edge network that controls bot and AI-agent traffic; Q2 revenue $696M (+36%), 120% net retention. Launched Basin Thursday, a serverless Apache Iceberg data lake on R2 with no egress fees, aimed at the S3-plus-Athena stack; $347.17 at 10:27 ET (flat), 3.5% under the Sep 22 record. T-Systems resells Cloudflare security across Europe and the public post-quantum CA launches Q1 2027.
risks: Trades above the $337 consensus target at ~47x sales, so any growth miss will be punished, and 5.33% 10-year yields compress exactly this kind of multiple. Gross margin fell 320bps to 73.1%; Basin is another product that needs years to show in revenue.

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Q2 revenue $7.8B (+48%): Shopee GMV +28%, Monee loan book $11.1B at 1.0% NPLs. $95.40 at 10:30 ET (-2.0%), falling faster than the market for a second day after DBS cut to Hold ($105 from $148); now -26% YTD and 14% below Sep 14. Morgan Stanley $153 and consensus ~$157 (+65%) still make it the widest gap on the list, but conviction drops to medium: the fundamentals have not changed, the tape has, and nothing is due until Nov 10.
risks: The downgrade gave sellers a reason and there is no catalyst for six weeks; a break of $95 opens the March post-earnings low. TikTok Shop and Temu in Southeast Asia, the Brazil push against MELI, Fitch flagging consumer credit risk at SeaBank Indonesia, and insiders selling small lots under 10b5-1 plans.

name: BYD
thesis: Exports drive growth: September NEV sales 463,561 (+17.0% YoY; passenger 456,713: 273,143 BEV, 183,570 PHEV), overseas 180,700, year-to-date 3.13M (-3.9%); a fifth straight monthly rise on exports offsetting a weak home market. Last trade HK$75.60 (Sep 30 close); Hong Kong was shut Thursday for National Day, so the number prices Friday. JPMorgan Neutral at HK$88, consensus HK$125.70 (+66%). USD at 7.8472 HKD.
risks: Domestic sales keep shrinking as Geely, Leapmotor (+59% in September) and Xpeng take share; the price war squeezes margins and first-half profit fell 20.5%. The stock sits on its 52-week low, and EU tariffs hang over the export engine that is doing all the work.
catalyst: HK reopens Fri Oct 2 to price September sales; Da Han launch 2026-10-13; Q3 2026 results 2026-10-29

name: Keyence Corp
thesis: Machine vision and sensors for factory automation and robotics; fiscal Q1 sales JPY 346.6B (+32.8%), net income +51% to JPY 139.1B, operating margin above 50%. Closed JPY 81,200 Thursday (+0.9%), a third straight up day and +6% since Sep 15, on no company news; at 157.98 yen per dollar that is $514. Bernstein reiterated Buy at JPY 95,000; 13 of 15 analysts at Buy, consensus JPY 97,867 (+21%).
risks: The premium multiple assumes 30%+ growth. A stronger yen or slower China capex would hit both earnings and the multiple; Toyota's August numbers show Chinese and US auto demand softening.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: Sole EUV supplier; 2026 guide EUR 43-45B at 54-56% gross margin, 2027 EUV capacity essentially sold out. $1,800.23 at 10:30 ET (-0.6%) on no company news; Micron's $61.5B Q1 guide and higher capex plan is next year's lithography orders. Still +14% since Sep 14; consensus $2,116 (+18%).
risks: China export limits and proposed US chip tariffs. Sentiment-driven days cut both ways (-7.3% on Sep 14), and the Oct 14 bookings number has to back the rally.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Test equipment for AI and HBM chips (~70% of revenue) plus Universal Robots cobots; Q2 revenue $1.33B, more than double. $410.55 at 10:30 ET (+2.4%), the best mover on the list with no company news: Micron's higher capex plan is more HBM wafers to test, and the Magnum E2 memory tester shows at SEMICON West Oct 13-15. Consensus $446 (+9%).
risks: The most volatile AI name on the list (-13.3% on Sep 14) at a premium multiple, now within 9% of consensus. Micron itself closed -2.5% after its beat, so the memory trade is fully priced for now; test orders are lumpy and come from a few customers.

name: Tesla
thesis: Car demand is falling while the valuation rests on robotaxi, storage and Optimus. Q3 deliveries land Friday before the open: company-compiled consensus 461,974, -7% YoY, range 421,758 to 482,000; energy storage consensus 15.9 GWh. Europe is the bright spot: September registrations +61.9% in France, +38.4% in Sweden, +24.8% in Spain, +2.2% in Norway, with Germany and the UK due later this week. $355.09 at 10:31 ET (flat), down about 5.5% this week into the print. Track it, don't chase it.
risks: A print below ~440K puts the stock back under the $350 level it has been defending; Europe is a small share of global deliveries. Free cash flow is thin at $25B+ capex, the auto-vote program smooths any SpaceX merger vote and Musk's pay, and the EU-wide FSD vote is December at the earliest.
catalyst: Q3 deliveries 2026-10-02 pre-market; Roadster demo 2026-10-15; Q3 earnings 2026-10-28
